<thought>Combine the two subnetworks, ensuring unique resistor identifiers and preserving all node connections. Subnet 1 provides resistors R1‑R3 and nodes A‑N1‑N2‑X1. Subnet 2 provides four resistors; to avoid name clashes they are renamed to R4‑R7 while keeping its nodes B‑N_b3‑N_b2‑N_b1‑X1. The combined topology should satisfy all given measurements, so we validate it before final submission.</thought>
